marketRegime.rationale: Mixed signals: commodity recovery and emerging-market policy shifts offset geopolitical friction and trade uncertainty; no cross-asset repricing event yet.

executivePulse.title: Spain Housing Crisis
executivePulse.text: Spain's rental scarcity and eviction restrictions dominating political agenda ahead of potential elections; housing affordability now electoral tipping point with direct impact on government stability and policy risk.

executivePulse.title: Copper Rebound
executivePulse.text: Copper posts first weekly gain in 7 weeks after 6.5% single-day surge, tracking improved risk appetite; signals modest shift in commodities seasonality but conviction remains low pending OPEC+ clarity.

executivePulse.title: Brazil Finance Shift
executivePulse.text: Lula appoints Bradesco banker Trabuco as finance minister, triggering asset rally; market interprets as constructive signal for fiscal discipline, though political consensus on spending remains unresolved.

opportunityRadar.theme: Guinea mining project finance and sovereign wealth

houseView.label: Spain & Madrid Real Estate
houseView.change: WSJ and DW reporting housing crisis as principal election issue; rental shortage and eviction legal constraints now dominating political discourse, raising regulatory risk for investor returns and exit timing.

houseView.label: European Credit & Financing
houseView.change: Nordic bond market emerging as PE funding source signals capital market adaptation; no fundamental credit regime change yet, but concentration of leverage in alternative funding channels warrants closer monitoring.

houseView.label: Private Capital Deployment
houseView.change: PE interest in legal services MSOs and value-add real estate allocation shifts continue; Alantra portfolio activity confirms Spain-based GP activity, but macro uncertainty and Spain housing headwinds narrow deployment windows.

houseView.label: Energy & Commodities
houseView.change: Copper posts first weekly gain in 7 weeks and Rio Tinto ships first Simandou iron ore cargo to Europe; oil prices mixed but stockpiling support flagged for 2027; risk appetite and supply-side catalysts offsetting seasonal weakness.

houseView.label: Emerging Markets
houseView.change: Brazil market rally on Bradesco banker appointment as finance minister signals fiscal credibility boost; India emerges as AI hub and Korea cuts rates to support growth; Argentina contraction noted but regional momentum nets constructive.

houseView.label: Global Risk Appetite
houseView.change: Copper surge and Brazil equity rally balanced against unresolved trade tariff uncertainty, Spain political risk, and Ukraine winter outlook; World Bank confirms growth persists but warns of deceleration; no catalyst for sustained appetite shift.

globalBriefing: Spain's housing crisis and political uncertainty eclipse European stability, while Brazil's finance minister appointment and India's AI positioning create emerging-market capital flows. Copper and iron ore recovery signal modest industrial demand stabilization, but trade tariff cycles and US chip restrictions undermine reshoring confidence and infrastructure deployment timing across Asia and LatAm. Central bank divergence—Korea tightening, World Bank confirming growth—sustains balanced risk appetite but introduces cross-border capital allocation complexity.
marketOpen: Monitor Spanish housing and electoral headlines for regulatory intervention signals; track OPEC+ meeting clarity on oil price guidance and 2027 stockpiling support; watch for trade tariff reversal or escalation confirmation that could reset reshoring and manufacturing capex cycles.

macro.label: Macro & Central Banks
macro.description: Central bank decisions, inflation prints, GDP, yield curves, and FX

items.headline: South Korea raises benchmark interest rate; Bank of Korea raises 2027 growth forecast to 4.1% from 2.9%
items.summary: Per Korea.net and China Daily, BoK tightens policy while upgrading medium-term growth outlook, signaling confidence in demand recovery. Rate move contradicts global disinflationary narrative; suggests regional wage and domestic demand pressures.
items.relevance: Asian monetary tightening cycle implies capital flows to higher-yield EM FX and bonds; reduces relative attraction of Eurozone fixed income.

items.headline: World Bank economist: global economy still expanding despite slower growth, no recession risk
items.summary: Per Malay Mail citing World Bank, global growth decelerating but economy avoiding contraction. Supports 'soft landing' narrative; undercuts recession hedges.
items.relevance: Validates continued capital allocation to growth; reduces defensive positioning and supports commodity and cyclical equity appetite.

items.headline: Fed faces fresh rate hike pressure as inflation and US growth defy expectations
items.summary: Per AzerNews, US data suggests persistent inflationary and growth dynamics contradicting Fed pause expectations. Headline lacks attribution to specific data points; conviction constrained.
items.relevance: If confirmed, higher US rate expectations widen dollar carry and reduce private capital returns in lower-yielding geographies; pressures EM FX.

items.headline: Indian central bank allows rupee to appreciate to break one-way depreciation bets
items.summary: Per Reuters, RBI shifts stance from rupee defense to managed appreciation, signaling confidence in capital flows and willingness to tighten. Tactical policy move; reduces currency hedge demand.
items.relevance: EM FX stabilization supports India equity and bond positioning; reduces hedging costs for cross-border investors into Indian assets.

items.headline: ECB Consumer Expectations Survey results (October 2026) released
items.summary: Per ECB Press Releases, survey data published but no headline figures cited. Survey measures inflation and wage expectations; relevant for forward guidance and Q4 policy signaling.
items.relevance: ECB inflation expectations anchor affects Eurozone real yields and credit spreads; impacts European fixed income and corporate financing costs.

macro.keyTakeaway: If EM central banks continue tightening while Fed remains in pause-or-hike hold, capital flows to higher-yielding EM bonds and currencies accelerate; if US inflation re-accelerates, dollar strength reverses EM rally and pressures emerging-market private capital returns.

geopolitics.label: Geopolitics & Security
geopolitics.description: Conflicts, alliances, sanctions, and power shifts

items.headline: Zelensky criticises Trump-Putin relationship and US negotiating effort as freezing weather sets in for winter
items.summary: Per BBC World, Ukraine president expresses concern over Trump's diplomatic approach and US commitment to forced negotiations as Ukraine faces winter offensives. Reflects geopolitical fracture between Washington and Kyiv.
items.relevance: Prolonged Ukraine conflict and negotiation uncertainty sustain European defense spending and energy premiums; direct impact on EU fiscal planning and NATO procurement cycles affecting private capital deployment in defense/infrastructure.

items.headline: Trump urges Putin to end military aggression in Europe; US postpones major military overhaul
items.summary: Per OilPrice.com, Trump calls for Russian de-escalation while US delays defense restructuring. Mixed signals: rhetorical pressure on Russia paired with delayed military commitment suggests conditional engagement.
items.relevance: Ambiguity on US military commitment to Europe affects NATO credibility and defense investment timing; risk of abrupt policy reversals creates decision risk for European infrastructure and security-related private capital.

items.headline: Israel's Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu's Likud of stalling coalition talks and dragging Israel toward new election
items.summary: Per Al Jazeera, Israeli coalition tensions persist; Yashar party chief signals electoral risk and political fragmentation. Reflects ongoing governance instability in Israel.
items.relevance: Israeli political instability delays policy clarity on regional integration and normalization; impacts cross-border trade and infrastructure financing in Eastern Mediterranean.

items.headline: Iran accused of deadly drone attack in Kuwait; EU calls for stepped-up pressure on Tehran
items.summary: Per CBS News, Iran accused of attack in Kuwait; EU responds with pressure escalation rhetoric. Reflects continued Middle East security deterioration and potential for sanctions escalation.
items.relevance: Iran sanctions risk and regional conflict escalation pressure oil prices and regional investment climate; direct implication for energy commodity positioning and Middle East infrastructure FDI.

items.headline: Serbia student-led movement nominates chemistry professor for presidency amid political flux
items.summary: Per BBC World, Serbian political realignment reflected in anti-establishment presidential candidacy. Signals broader Central European political volatility.
items.relevance: Central European political instability creates regulatory and policy risk for cross-border capital deployment; relevant for private equity and infrastructure investors with regional exposure.

geopolitics.keyTakeaway: If Trump-Putin dialogue produces de-escalation, Ukraine conflict defunding and European defense spending normalization create reallocation risk; if geopolitical friction persists, energy premiums and security-related infrastructure spending sustain higher costs for investors with European exposure.

fdi.label: FDI & Capital Flows
fdi.description: Cross-border investments, sovereign wealth, and capital movements

items.headline: China Railway Resources Group plans $600 million investment in Zimbabwe gold mines
items.summary: Per Reuters Capital, Chinese investor commits major capital to African precious metals; reflects continued Chinese resource-capture strategy in Africa.
items.relevance: Chinese FDI into African gold signals competing capital flows and reduced openness for Western investors in critical mineral supply chains; affects commodity pricing power and Western supply diversification timelines.

items.headline: Guinea lawmakers back sovereign wealth fund fuelled by Simandou iron ore revenue
items.summary: Per Reuters Capital, Guinea parliament approves SWF structure for Simandou project; enables long-term resource-linked investment vehicle. Rio Tinto ships first cargo to Europe in early December.
items.relevance: Simandou project completion and SWF launch create new capital deployment vector for European and global investors; long-term offtake agreements and equity stakes available for private capital; relevant to real assets and infrastructure allocations.

items.headline: US chip curbs will slow Asia data-center investment, Fitch says
items.summary: Per Reuters Capital citing Fitch, US semiconductor export controls to China dampen regional data-center capex cycle. Direct policy impact on private infrastructure investment pace.
items.relevance: US chip sanctions reduce Asia data-center and cloud infrastructure deployment rates; slows private capital deployment windows for infrastructure GPs targeting hyperscaler builds; extends IRR uncertainty.

items.headline: Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute aims to bring $60 trillion purse to G20 investment summit
items.summary: Per The National, SWF coordination efforts underway to mobilize capital into G20-flagged projects. Structural capital availability announcement but no concrete allocation targets cited.
items.relevance: Coordinated SWF deployment signals capital ready to move into announced infrastructure; creates competitive pressure and improved terms for private sponsors; supports infrastructure equity and hybrid debt markets.

items.headline: IFC's Makhtar Diop: bundled airport investments attract larger investors than single-asset offerings
items.summary: Per The Africa Report citing IFC director, infrastructure packaging strategy emphasized to unlock scale capital. Reflects practitioner view on deal structuring for EM infrastructure.
items.relevance: Infrastructure bundling and platform strategies support private capital deployment into African airports and transport; relevant to infrastructure GPs and co-investment frameworks in emerging markets.

fdi.keyTakeaway: If Simandou SWF and Guinea resource monetization proceed on schedule, African infrastructure and resource-linked private capital deployment accelerates; if US chip curbs expand, Asia-focused data-center and hyperscaler infrastructure IRRs compress and capital rebalances toward other geographies.

critical-minerals.label: Commodities & Energy
critical-minerals.description: Oil, gas, metals, supply chains, and energy security

items.headline: Copper posts first weekly gain in nearly two months; LME prices up 6.5% on improved risk sentiment
items.summary: Per OilPrice.com, copper rallies sharply after extended weakness; first positive week since early October. Reflects tactical short-covering and modest demand recovery signal.
items.relevance: Copper rebound signals industrial demand stabilization and construction/EV cycle resumption; supports commodity thesis for real assets allocation and energy transition infrastructure capex.

items.headline: Rio Tinto ships first Simandou iron ore cargo (79,081 tonnes) to Dunkirk, France; arrival early December
items.summary: Per Mining.com, Simandou project reaches export phase with first cargo bound for Europe. Marks operational milestone for 20+ year project timeline.
items.relevance: Iron ore supply diversification into Europe reduces Chinese pricing power and stabilizes steel input costs; supports European steelmaker margins and downstream industrial investment cases; validates Guinea project monetization.

items.headline: Oil prices mixed ahead of OPEC+ meeting; Middle East supply risks persist; stockpiling expected to support 2027 prices
items.summary: Per WSJ and OilPrice.com, oil trading range-bound with structural support flagged for 2027. OPEC+ meeting timing unspecified; supply-side risks (Iran, Middle East) underlying geopolitical premium.
items.relevance: OPEC+ clarity and stockpiling cycle affect energy inflation and power generation costs across Europe; material for energy transition capex modeling and infrastructure IRR assumptions.

items.headline: Indonesia discusses first subsidized fuel price increase since 2022 amid weak currency and high oil costs
items.summary: Per OilPrice.com, Indonesian policymakers weigh subsidy reform on currency weakness and oil price pressures. No decision yet; reflects regional inflation pass-through risk.
items.relevance: Indonesian fuel subsidy reform signals broader emerging-market policy tightening and fiscal pressure; affects EM currency valuations and cost-of-living inflation, moderating private consumption and infrastructure demand.

items.headline: South Sudan readies licensing round for five oil blocks to boost production capacity
items.summary: Per OilPrice.com, South Sudan petroleum ministry announces new block licensing; aims to expand oil output. Reflects resource monetization strategy in conflict-affected region.
items.relevance: South Sudan oil production increase supports global supply diversification but carries sovereign and security risk; relevant for commodity traders hedging OPEC+ and Middle East supply constraints.

critical-minerals.keyTakeaway: If copper and iron ore recovery sustains and Simandou ramps to full capacity, industrial commodity prices stabilize and support energy transition capex; if OPEC+ tightens production or Middle East risks escalate, oil prices re-rate higher and energy input inflation pressures private capital returns across non-energy sectors.

real-estate.label: Real Estate & Infrastructure
real-estate.description: Institutional RE, infrastructure projects, and market trends

items.headline: Spain's housing crisis becomes main election issue as rental shortage and eviction restrictions persist
items.summary: Per WSJ and DW, Spanish housing affordability dominates electoral discourse; rental scarcity and legal constraints on evictions frustrate market clearing. Crisis now top-tier political priority.
items.relevance: Housing policy becomes electoral tipping point and regulatory wildcard; potential for rent controls, eviction bans, or new construction mandates to reshape Spanish real estate investment cases; direct impact on residential yields and exit timing.

items.headline: Spain's election could pull Madrid closer to Trump's Washington; Sánchez voters may bring him down
items.summary: Per CNBC and CNN, Spanish electoral outcome expected to reshape geopolitical alignment and domestic fiscal priorities. Political uncertainty on leadership and direction.
items.relevance: Spanish electoral outcome affects regulatory environment for foreign capital, fiscal spending priorities, and EU positioning; creates policy risk for Madrid real estate and infrastructure investors dependent on EU funding or immigration policy.

items.headline: No Homes to Rent, No Way to Evict: Inside Spain's Housing Crisis
items.summary: Per WSJ, Spanish rental market dysfunction reflects legal barriers to eviction and undersupply of rental stock. Market failure creates policy pressure for government intervention.
items.relevance: Rental market breakdown signals potential for disruptive regulation (rent caps, tenant protections, development mandates); affects residential real estate valuations, development yields, and long-term hold strategies.

items.headline: AmanahRaya REIT reports 3Q net income up 14.3% on lower property costs; AmFIRST REIT shows higher FY2027 Q2 revenue and profit
items.summary: Per Malaysian Reserve and PropNewsTime, Asian REIT earnings improve on cost discipline and revenue growth. Reflects regional commercial real estate recovery.
items.relevance: Asian REIT performance signals commercial property market stabilization and cost control effectiveness; supports private capital deployment into regional office and logistics platforms.

real-estate.keyTakeaway: If Spanish electoral outcome drives housing regulation toward rent controls or development mandates, residential real estate yields compress and foreign capital retreats; if Madrid government sustains pro-market policy, Spanish residential and commercial platforms remain viable but face persistent political headwind.

ma-growth.label: M&A & Private Capital
ma-growth.description: Deal flow, PE/VC activity, and corporate transactions

items.headline: Deudafix, portfolio company of Alantra Private Equity, acquires Evalúa Mis Finanzas
items.summary: Per Alantra announcement, Spanish PE firm executes add-on acquisition in fintech-adjacent financial services. Reflects active deployment in Spain-based portfolio.
items.relevance: Alantra portfolio activity demonstrates continued private capital deployment and M&A momentum in Spain despite electoral uncertainty; supports thesis that Spanish middle-market consolidation continues.

items.headline: Uber secures 87.13% of Delivery Hero shares in takeover bid; mega-cap consolidation advances
items.summary: Per TradingView, Uber exceeds majority threshold for Delivery Hero acquisition. Large-scale tech/logistics consolidation; demonstrates capital available for growth equity and M&A in platform businesses.
items.relevance: Platform M&A momentum and strategic buyer confidence signal continued appetite for growth-stage digital businesses; supports private capital deployment thesis for high-growth tech platforms and logistics.

items.headline: Private equity firms access Nordic bond market as new debt source amid capital market concentration
items.summary: Per WSJ, PE firms leverage Nordic credit markets for portfolio financing; reflects alternative funding channel development and capital market adaptation.
items.relevance: PE funding diversification into Northern Europe credit markets implies less reliance on US credit; supports European PE return profiles but signals capital market fragmentation and execution risk on exit refinancing.

items.headline: Sheppard launches legal MSO practice as private equity interest in law firms accelerates
items.summary: Per Daily Journal, PE deployment into professional services and legal consolidation platform-building accelerates. Reflects professional services as growth sector for PE capital.
items.relevance: PE appetite for legal services and MSO platforms suggests capital available for consolidation plays in regulated professional services; supports higher multiples for quality platforms.

items.headline: Ohio PERS trims private equity target allocation in favor of value-add real estate
items.summary: Per IPE Real Assets, large US pension reallocates from PE toward value-add real estate; signals subtle shift in allocator preference within alternatives.
items.relevance: Allocator shift away from PE into real estate implies capital competition intensifying for real asset managers; suggests PE fundraising may tighten while real estate/infrastructure platforms attract LP flows.

items.headline: Sovereign wealth funds acting more like private equity giants and inheriting their risks
items.summary: Per CNBC, SWF deployment strategies converge with PE behavior and risk profiles; structural shift in sovereign investor posture.
items.relevance: SWF shift toward PE-like operations implies increased competition for private capital managers and potential for liquidity crises if SWF redemption pressure emerges; relevant to co-investment partnerships and capital availability.

ma-growth.keyTakeaway: If allocators continue shifting from PE into real estate/infrastructure, PE fundraising faces headwinds and exit multiples compress; if SWF deployment as quasi-PE managers scales, competition for deal flow intensifies and sponsor returns contract across private capital.

emerging-markets.label: Emerging Markets
emerging-markets.description: Frontier opportunities, risk signals, and market access

items.headline: Lula appoints Bradesco banker Luiz Carlos Trabuco as Brazil finance minister; assets rally on appointment
items.summary: Per Bloomberg and Jacksonville Journal-Courier, Brazil president names respected banking executive to fiscal leadership; market interprets as credible signal for fiscal discipline. Asset prices re-rate higher on confidence.
items.relevance: Trabuco appointment reduces fiscal risk premium and supports Brazil equity and credit re-rating; direct positive catalyst for emerging-market capital flows into Brazil assets; relevant to private equity and infrastructure deployment windows.

items.headline: India emerges as AI haven and seeks boost from new US chip curbs on China
items.summary: Per Bloomberg, India positioned to benefit from US semiconductor restrictions on Chinese competitors; regulatory tailwind for Indian tech and AI development.
items.relevance: India tech beneficiary status from US China restrictions supports equity and venture capital deployment; creates multi-year advantage for Indian software and AI platforms attracting cross-border growth capital.

items.headline: Argentina's economy shrinks y/y for third consecutive month; economy minister dismisses recession label
items.summary: Per IntelliNews, Argentine GDP contracts for third month running; policymaker messaging minimizes severity. Structural economic contraction evident despite rhetoric.
items.relevance: Argentina recession risk remains elevated despite government downplaying; reduces private capital deployment appetite and extends capital strike into 2027; affects LatAm portfolio diversification strategies.

items.headline: Mexico weighs limits of politically popular wage strategy amid fiscal constraints
items.summary: Per Yahoo Finance, Mexican policymakers assess sustainability of wage-driven demand policy; reflects fiscal tradeoff analysis.
items.relevance: Mexican wage inflation policy creates medium-term currency and fiscal risk; affects emerging-market currency valuations and infrastructure IRR assumptions for LatAm investors.

items.headline: Huawei found guilty of trade secrets theft in US trial; not guilty of RICO charges
items.summary: Per Asia Times, US federal jury convicts Huawei on intellectual property violation but acquits on broader racketeering claims. Mixed verdict reflects targeted prosecution outcome.
items.relevance: Huawei conviction reinforces US-China tech decoupling and IP enforcement regime; affects cross-border tech investment and licensing strategies for emerging-market tech platforms.

emerging-markets.keyTakeaway: If Brazil fiscal credibility holds and India tech beneficiary narrative sustains, emerging-market capital flows shift toward these two markets; if Argentina contraction deepens and Mexico fiscal pressures mount, LatAm private capital allocation narrows to Brazil and diversifies away from region.

trade-policy.label: Trade & Industrial Policy
trade-policy.description: Tariffs, sanctions, export controls, and economic statecraft

items.headline: Trump embraces Xi, then slaps new tariffs on China; strategy unclear amid competing signals
items.summary: Per Al Jazeera, Trump administration applies tariffs on Chinese goods even after reported diplomatic outreach. Mixed messaging creates policy uncertainty.
items.relevance: US tariff uncertainty and policy reversal risk create execution risk for supply chain and manufacturing strategies; affects reshoring timeline and trade-flow forecasting for private capital deployment.

items.headline: New tariffs on China risk undermining trade truce with US; deal durability questioned
items.summary: Per WSJ, US tariff application jeopardizes claimed trade ceasefire; deal fragility signals ongoing escalation risk.
items.relevance: Trade truce collapse or repeated tariff cycles increase supply-chain volatility and defer manufacturing reshoring capex; direct impact on infrastructure and logistics private capital deployment timelines.

items.headline: Dutch PM to discuss MATCH Act chipmaking export controls with Trump at G20 summit
items.summary: Per Reuters, Netherlands government engages Trump administration on semiconductor export restrictions. Multilateral diplomacy underway to coordinate or moderate controls.
items.relevance: MATCH Act enforcement and G20 negotiation outcome affect semiconductor supply and data-center infrastructure capex across Europe and Asia; relevant to real assets and infrastructure private capital timing.

items.headline: Global G20 import barriers cover record $4.5 trillion; protectionism at historic high
items.summary: Per WTO via Fibre2Fashion, G20 import barriers reach record level; reflects sustained protectionist momentum globally.
items.relevance: Record protectionism dampens cross-border trade and capital flows; extends reshoring and supply-chain diversification capex cycle; affects emerging-market export platform valuations negatively.

items.headline: Trump embraces XI, then slaps new tariffs on China; Republicans rethink tariffs as Democrats see political opening
items.summary: Per ABC News, US Republican consensus on tariffs fractures; domestic political opposition to trade restrictions emerges.
items.relevance: Political fracture on tariff strategy introduces policy reversal risk and reduces tariff credibility; creates optionality for manufacturers and supply-chain investors on reshoring timing.

trade-policy.keyTakeaway: If Trump tariff regime hardens and G20 protectionism sustains, trade-dependent emerging markets and cross-border capital flows compress; if Republican domestic opposition and negotiation dilute tariffs, reshoring capex delays and trade-flow volatility persists.

food-agriculture.label: Food & Agriculture
food-agriculture.description: Food security, agribusiness, and agricultural commodities

items.headline: Copper and soybeans rally pre-holiday on technical buying; corn and soybeans rally as China boosts demand
items.summary: Per AgWeb and AgroLatam, agricultural commodity prices lift on demand signals and technical factors. Grain markets responding to Chinese purchasing activity.
items.relevance: Agricultural commodity price recovery supports farm input cost management and farmer margin recovery; relevant to agricultural private capital deployment and food-system infrastructure investment.

items.headline: Drought fears and high input costs shadow South African maize farmers; weather risk in focus
items.summary: Per Food For Mzansi, South African agricultural sector faces dual pressure from drought and elevated input costs. Regional production risk elevated.
items.relevance: South African agricultural stress signals food security risk and import dependency; affects grain price volatility and regional food-system investment attractiveness.

items.headline: Natural gas expansion could reshape fertilizer prices and farm costs
items.summary: Per AgroLatam, natural gas infrastructure development expected to influence fertilizer economics and agricultural input pricing. Structural shift in cost dynamics.
items.relevance: Natural gas-linked fertilizer pricing creates multi-year commodity linkage; affects agricultural yield and profitability forecasting for food-system private capital and agtech deployment.

items.headline: El Salvador's TLÁLOC raises capital for digital agriculture and cybersecurity platform development
items.summary: Per AgFunder News, Salvadoran agtech startup funds product commercialization in digital farming and agricultural cyber defense.
items.relevance: Central American agtech capital deployment signals venture and growth equity appetite in emerging-market agricultural technology; relevant to private capital deployment into food-system digitalization.

food-agriculture.keyTakeaway: If China demand for agricultural commodities sustains and natural gas fertilizer economics improve, agricultural margins recover and attract private capital; if drought stress spreads or commodity prices collapse, food-system infrastructure capex defers and agtech fundraising tightens.
